title: Administrator (Renewable Energy)
description:

Office Based - Cambridge
27,000 - 35,000 + Progression to Senior Level + Renewables Training + Private Healthcare + Pension + Holiday

Supporting the day-to-day administration of a growing renewables business

Office based in Cambridge, 40 hours per week
The Person:
Administrative experience
Background in the mechanical and/or electrical engineering industry
Organised, personable and able to take ownership of their own workload
Commutable to Cambridge

title: HR Coordinator
company: S&B Herba Foods Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Location: Fulbourn, Cambridgeshire CB21 5 ET

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: Mon - Friday 9am - 5.30pm

About the Company:

S&B Herba Foods Ltd source and import rice and grains (and other raw materials) from across the globe to produce a wide range of ingredients to the specification of UK manufacturers and wholesalers. Our core purpose is to "Feed the nation and be a place where everyone can reach their full potential".

We have just been awarded the Investors In People standard and are embarking on a new era to attain Silver with our ultimate goal Platinum.

In order to do this, we need people that are willing to drive our Goals and Ambitions and continually improve and develop themselves as individuals, with our full support.

Our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We Before I - We succeed by collaborating and supporting one another
- Proactive - We take ownership, anticipate challenges and find solutions
- Can Do - We approach every task with positivity and determination
- Hungry - We are driven to learn, improve and achieve more every day

If these values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you.

We have been trading for over 100 years and have a great heritage.

Come and join us - it's a great place to work!

About The Role:

We are looking for an enthusiastic, people-focused HR Coordinator to join our team, reporting directly to the HR Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, enjoys variety and wants to build a long-term career in Human Resources whilst helping to create a positive workplace culture.

As our HR Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our people, culture and day-to-day operations. This new and varied position combines HR administration, employee engagement and front-of-house responsibilities. Although based at Cambridge, you will also be supporting our Liverpool site.

You will also contribute to our journey towards achieving Investors in People Silver accreditation, helping to shape initiatives that support employee development and engagement.

Key responsibilities include:
- HR administration: Provide comprehensive support throughout the employee lifecycle and maintain accurate, confidential employee records and documentation.
- Recruitment and onboarding: Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activities.
- Engagement and wellbeing: Coordinate employee engagement and wellbeing initiatives, including projects supporting our Investors in People Silver accreditation.
- Learning and Development Coordination: Support the delivery of the Company's learning and development strategy by coordinating training programmes and courses, maintaining training and skill matrices, tracking completion of mandatory and role-specific training, producing training reports, and promoting continuous professional development opportunities.
- Manager support: Assist managers with HR processes, handling sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Continuous improvement: Help improve HR processes and support the HR Manager in terms of the service HR provides to the Company at both sites.
- Front-of-house: Delivering a professional front-of-house reception service, acting as the first point of contact for visitors, employees and external stakeholders. This will include the managing of meeting rooms, post and couriers.

About you:

We are looking for someone who:
- Is passionate about building a career in Human Resources
- Has a university degree in Human Resources or a related discipline, or is keen to pursue an HR degree or professional qualification, such as CIPD, whilst working
- Is highly organised and has excellent attention to detail
- Handles confidential information with integrity and discretion
- Communicates confidently and enjoys working with people at all levels
- Is friendly and professional, creating a positive first impression for visitors
- Is proactive, adaptable and able to manage a varied workload
- Is committed to living our company values every day

What We Offer:
- The opportunity to build a rewarding career in Human Resources
- A varied and rewarding role in which no two days are the same
- The opportunity to contribute to meaningful employee engagement initiatives
- A collaborative, supportive working environment shaped by our core values
- The chance to be part of our journey towards Investors in People Silver accreditation

Benefits:
- 22 days holiday (plus bank holidays) increasing each year by one day until a max of 25 days
- Pension Scheme + Life Assurance
- Income Protection
- Free onsite car parking
- Bike to Work Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Support to pursue further professional qualifications
- Free rice (quarterly)

Please click the APPLY button and to submit your CV and Cover Letter.

Candidates with experience of: Human Resource Officer, Human Resource Administrator, HR Admin, HR Generalist, HR Officer, HR Specialist, Employee Relations Specialist, Employee Relations Advisor, Employee Relations Manager, HR Business Partner, HR Manager may also be considered for this role.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist

Location: Cambridge, CB5 8 PA
Salary: Competitive, DOE
Contract: Full-time, Permanent- Monday to Friday (with participation in the weekend rota required)

About Peasgood & Skeates

Peasgood & Skeates is a long-established, family-owned independent funeral directors with a proud history of serving families and communities across Essex, Cambridgeshire, Suffolk and the surrounding areas.

We understand that losing someone you care about is one of the most difficult experiences in life. Our role is to provide families with care, compassion and professionalism at every stage, and our people are at the heart of delivering that service.

We are now looking for an experienced Receptionist to join our flagship Cambridge office.

About the Role

As our Receptionist, you will be the first person a bereaved family meets and will play a vital role in creating a warm, welcoming and supportive experience.

This is much more than a traditional reception role. You'll combine front-of-house responsibilities with a varied administrative workload, coordinating appointments, handling enquiries, supporting Funeral Directors and liaising with a range of external contacts.

You'll need genuine warmth and emotional intelligence, alongside the ability to remain calm, organised and professional when dealing with sensitive situations and competing priorities.

What You'll Be Doing
- Welcoming bereaved families, visitors and members of the public with warmth, dignity and discretion.
- Handling telephone enquiries sensitively, including initial calls following a death.
- Managing appointments, viewings and chapel of rest arrangements.
- Coordinating diaries and information between families, Funeral Directors and third parties.
- Liaising with clergy, celebrants, crematoria, cemeteries, doctors, coroners, florists and other suppliers.
- Preparing, completing and maintaining funeral paperwork and records accurately.
- Handling payments, invoices and account queries.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post, email and general correspondence.
- Ensuring reception, meeting rooms and public areas are maintained to an excellent standard.
- Providing wider administrative and branch support as required.
- Handling highly sensitive information with absolute confidentiality and in line with GDPR and company procedures.
- Supporting local community activities, events and fundraising where required.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Proven experience in a front-of-house or receptionist role this is mandatory.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- A warm, professional and empathetic telephone manner.
- High emotional intelligence and the ability to respond appropriately to people who may be distressed or grieving.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to remain calm and composed while managing multiple priorities.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office, with the confidence to learn new systems.
- Absolute discretion, integrity and professionalism.
- A smart and professional appearance and manner.
- A flexible, helpful approach and genuine commitment to providing excellent service.

Desirable:
- Previous or current experience within the funeral industry.
- Knowledge of Cambridge and the surrounding area.
- Experience dealing with funeral-related organisations or third parties.
- Experience in another client-facing role involving sensitive or emotionally challenging situations.
- Full UK driving licence.

A Role That Makes a Difference

This is a rewarding opportunity to become an important part of a team supporting families during some of the most difficult moments of their lives. The role can be emotionally demanding, and you may occasionally come into contact with the deceased, so we ask applicants to consider this carefully.

In return, you'll join a well-established family business with a strong reputation for care, professionalism and service, where the contribution you make to families and the local community genuinely matters.

If you're an experienced receptionist who combines professionalism with compassion, discretion and genuine warmth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and a short covering note explaining why this opportunity appeals to you.

No agencies please.

title: Communications & Events Executive
description:
Communications and Events Executive

Positive and enthusiastic approach to all tasks and challenges

Professional demeanour

Resilience and composure under pressure.

Eagerness to learn and engage in ongoing professional development.

Excellent punctuality and strong record of attendance.

Determination to succeed, even when faced with challenges.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist
- Location: PE6
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Specialist to drive the day-to-day execution of our marketing plans. This role is pivotal in managing digital campaigns across PPC, SEO, email, and social media, and supports the Head of Marketing in delivering tactical campaigns and coordinating events. The ideal candidate will be a dynamic marketer with a strong background in digital execution and campaign management.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Implement and manage strategic email marketing and PPC campaigns, tracking performance to optimize lead generation.
- Conduct research to identify potential B2 B customers in sectors like agriculture, wastewater, construction, and events.
- Manage the inbound lead pipeline, coordinate with sales for lead transfers, and nurture customers to maximize conversion rates.
- Write and edit high-quality copy for marketing collateral, product applications, and website landing pages.
- Act as the internal "super-user" for the website, managing routine updates, new product uploads, and on-page SEO optimization.
- Serve as the primary liaison for external digital agencies, providing content assets and monitoring deliverables.
- Coordinate the communication of industry events and trade shows, working closely with the Sales team.

- Compile regular analytics reports on digital traffic, email engagement, and competitor activity.

- 3-5 years of broad marketing experience, with a focus on digital execution, content creation, and campaign coordination.
- Proficient in using digital marketing tools like Canva or Adobe Creative Suite, with a preference for candidates with HubSpot experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with experience in managing social media and email campaigns.
- Highly organised and reliable, capable of managing multiple tasks and schedules.
- Strong CRM and analytical skills to maintain accurate lead records and produce insightful reports.
- Team player, comfortable collaborating with external stakeholders and willing to travel for trade shows.
- Proactive and mature mindset, able to manage daily operations and make decisions in the absence of the Head of Marketing.
- Background or interest in rainwater harvesting, water treatment, or B2 B environments is advantageous.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic and supportive work environment.
- Flexible working hours with potential for remote work arrangements.

title: Owned Brand Manager
description:
We're looking for an experienced Owned Brand Manager to join our growing commercial team and take responsibility for the development, performance and long-term strategy of our owned brands. You'll be accountable for delivering profitable growth through compelling product ranges, clear brand positioning and excellent cross-functional collaboration across design, supply chain, merchandising, marketing and retail.

What you'll do:
- Own the end-to-end brand roadmap, from concept and product development through to launch, lifecycle management and rationalisation.
- Develop and maintain strong brand positioning and value propositions that resonate with our target customers and support channel strategies (stores, online and wholesale where applicable).
- Translate market insights, customer feedback and commercial data into actionable product specifications, features and price architecture.
- Work closely with design and product teams to brief, approve and iterate ranges, ensuring consistency of quality, fit for purpose specification and cost targets.
- Partner with supply chain and buying to set order plans, margin targets and inventory strategies that balance availability and working capital.
- Develop seasonal range plans, promotional calendars and NPD pipelines that drive sales and margin improvements.
- Liaise with marketing and visual teams to create impactful launch packs, product copy, imagery and in-store merchandising tools.
- Monitor brand and SKU performance, producing regular commercial reviews and taking timely corrective action where required.
- Manage stakeholder relationships and influence senior decision making through clear commercial rationale and reporting.
- Champion sustainability and cost-efficiency opportunities in product design and sourcing.

What we're dreaming of seeing:

We want someone who combines strong commercial acumen with creative flair and excellent project management. You'll be data-driven, customer-focused and able to balance short-term trading needs with long-term brand building.
- Proven experience in brand, product or range management, ideally within furniture, homewares, sleep or fast-moving retail categories.
- Demonstrable track record of delivering profitable NPD and range performance against sales and margin targets.
- Strong numeracy and commercial analysis skills, able to interpret sales, margin and inventory metrics.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to lead cross-functional projects.
- Knowledge of product specification, costing and supply chain processes, with experience of working alongside offshore suppliers an advantage.
- Organised, proactive and able to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced retail environment.
- Degree or equivalent experience in marketing, business, product design or a relevant discipline is desirable.

The best sleep is when we feel comfortable

We believe in creating a workplace where everyone can be their authentic self. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and treat all candidates with respect. If you're passionate about building brands and delivering great customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

The cool side of the pillow (our benefits):

We offer a competitive package and a range of colleague benefits to support your wellbeing, career and financial security:
- Competitive base salary with role appropriate bonus and performance incentives.
- Colleague discount across our product ranges.
- Health and wellbeing support including employee assistance services and cash-back options for selected therapies.
- Financial: Group Income Protection and pension scheme provided by Legal & General.
- Leave: generous annual leave entitlement with buy & sell flexibility and enhanced parental leave.
- Your Career: learning and development programmes and access to internal progression opportunities.
- Group Life Assurance of 2x annual salary and ongoing recognition schemes.
